requirements.quote:
Except for a few differences, QUIC version 2 endpoints MUST implement
   the QUIC version 1 specification as described in [QUIC], [QUIC-TLS],
   and [QUIC-RECOVERY].
requirements.condition: except for the differences specified for QUIC version 2
requirements.required_behavior: implement the QUIC version 1 specification described in [QUIC], [QUIC-TLS], and [QUIC-RECOVERY]
requirements.why_checkable: The QUIC version 2 implementation can be inspected and tested for conformance to the referenced QUIC version 1 specifications outside the enumerated differences.
